name: Aldeacentenera (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aldeacentenera (an ear of wheat between two bulls on red and white).
history: The arms and the flag of Aldeacentenera were approved by the Order of 29 September 1992 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 8 October 1992, approved by the Consejero de Presidencia y Trabajo Manuel Amigo after the municipal council's approval on 18 February 1992.

features.role: Aldeacentenera arms — ear of wheat between bulls
